intro.text: A spren city and major trading port in Shadesmar, on the Sea of Lost Lights, a free city until Voidspren took partial control.

description.text: Celebrant sits on the western side of the island that mirrors the Sea of Spears. Its docks are longer than the city itself, lined with warehouses, and a cultivationspren keeps the dock register.
Its market sells clothing, weapons, food and art, some from as far off as Nalthis; prices depend on how permanent an item is in Shadesmar. Like the rest of Shadesmar, it uses Stormlight as currency.
Many kinds of spren live there, but humans and honorspren are rare and draw attention. Spren fashion borrows from human styles across Roshar.

items.text: In the first months of the True Desolation, Voidspren took partial control of the city, mostly through a few officials, while some spren quietly opposed Odium's rule.
Wanted posters of Syl hung in the city when Kaladin, Shallan and Adolin passed through, stranded in Shadesmar.
